activity_records.entity: soluble bactericidal agent extracted from soil bacillus

target.strain: 8 strains: virulent encapsulated types I, II, III, V, VIII and rough derivatives

assay_conditions.assay_type: bacterial extract exposure followed by lysis and viability readout
assay_conditions.source_table: Table I, Effect of a Soluble Bacterial Extract on Different Microbial Species
assay_conditions.cell_density: about 10^9 cells per cc; 1 cc suspension treated and made to 2 cc final volume
assay_conditions.viability_readout: subsequent streak on blood agar plates
assay_conditions.lysis_readout: turbidity readings confirmed by microscopic examination
assay_conditions.table_symbol_key: C complete lysis; P partial lysis; N no lysis; minus no growth on blood agar; plus signs indicate reduced or abundant growth; NR no methylene-blue reduction; CR complete reduction
assay_conditions.table_outcome: Viability no growth at 0.01 mg; partial lysis at 0.01 mg and complete lysis at higher table doses.

supports: Table I dose columns and prose identify pneumococci as killed by 0.01 mg per 10^9 cells.

activity_records.interpretation: Primary source supports susceptibility of pneumococci to the soluble extract; it does not report a peptide sequence or MIC.
